name: mirage
text: Understood. The engine sees about 1,200 candidate bid lines but only 6-16 pass the desk's checks and stay up, and its status doesn't say why the rest are rejected. I won't loosen the quality rules blind, so I'm adding that reason count to the engine's bid status. Once it runs I'll loosen the one rule that is holding back the most, if the data shows it's safe, and tell you which. I'll tell you here when it's live.
